question: For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', and where the department offers at least 5 unique subjects with at least one associated TIP material and total units greater than 0, provide the offering department name, offering school name, average and variance of the number of enrolled students in those courses, the number of unique subjects, and the minimum total units for those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH rq_subjects AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID
    FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
    JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
    WHERE tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE = 'RQ'
),
subject_units AS (
    SELECT rs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rs.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, rs.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_units
    FROM rq_subjects rs
    JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = rs.SUBJECT_ID
    WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0
    GROUP BY rs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rs.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, rs.SUBJECT_ID
),
qualifying_depts AS (
    SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
    FROM subject_units
    GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) >= 5
)
SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS offering_department_name,
    tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS offering_school_name,
    AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled,
    VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_enrolled,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects,
    MIN(su.min_units) AS min_total_units
FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
JOIN subject_units su ON su.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND su.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AND su.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID
JOIN qualifying_depts qd ON qd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND qd.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
